message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded audio files or metadata CSVs anywhere in the data-acquisition path.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths (./data/...) with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication present in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, validation against expected label sets, or label-noise detection tools are used anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious input filtering is applied to the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code only initializes fresh model weights via network.MelCNN2d() and saves them with TrainCache().save(); there is no loading of pretrained weights and no hash/signature/pinned-revision verification anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected label distribution validation: No code inspects or validates class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection mechanisms.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus) or DP-SGD mechanisms.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or FGSM/PGD attack generation are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: The k-fold split uses random (not stratified) splitting with overlapping possibilities, there is no isolated held-out test set separate from validation, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and model selection is based solely on validation F1 which could be overfit across folds.
No detected input sanitization: Audio files are loaded and converted to mel spectrograms without any shape, range, or validity checks before being passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are used directly via argmax with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or confidence threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
